desc: Ideation: digit DP over (sum, capped prime exponents 2/3/5/7, has_zero flag); answer = f(r) − f(l−1)

Implement solution: precompute req[s] for s in 1..81 via trial division (flag s with prime factor > 7 as impossible-without-zero); memoized DP(pos, tight, started, sum, e2, e3, e5, e7, has_zero) with caps (6,4,2,2); leaf returns 1 iff started and (has_zero or exponents dominate req[sum]); f(x) over digit list of x, f(0)=0; beautifulNumbers = f(r) − f(l−1)
Validate against examples (10..20 → 2; 1..15 → 10) and brute-force cross-check on small ranges (e.g., up to 10^4) plus edge cases l = r = 1 and r = 999999999
